title: Deep Learning-based Approaches for State Space Models: A Selective Review
abstract: arXiv:2412.11211v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: State-space models (SSMs) offer a powerful framework for dynamical system analysis, wherein the temporal dynamics of the system are assumed to be captured through the evolution of the latent states, which govern the values of the observations. This paper provides a selective review of recent advancements in deep neural network-based approaches for SSMs, and presents a unified perspective for discrete-time deep state space models and continuous-time ones such as latent neural Ordinary Differential and Stochastic Differential Equations. It starts with an overview of the classical maximum likelihood based approach for learning SSMs, reviews the variational autoencoder as a general learning pipeline for neural network-based approaches in the presence of latent variables, and discusses in detail representative deep learning models that fall under the SSM framework. translated_title: 基于深度学习的状态空间模型方法：选择性综述
translated_abstract: 状态空间模型（SSMs）为动力系统分析提供了一个强大的框架，其中假设系统的时间动态通过潜在状态的演化来捕捉，而这些潜在状态决定着观测值。本文对基于深度神经网络的SSMs方法的最新进展进行了选择性综述，并为离散时间深度状态空间模型和连续时间模型（如潜在神经常微分方程与随机微分方程）提供了统一的视角。文章首先概述了基于经典最大似然方法的SSMs学习方式，回顾了变分自编码器作为存在潜在变量情况下基于神经网络方法的一般学习流程，并详细讨论了属于SSM框架的代表性深度学习模型。此外，还介绍了最新的研究进展，即SSMs被用作独立架构……
tldr: 本文对基于深度学习的状态空间模型方法进行了选择性综述，为离散时间与连续时间（如潜在神经ODE和SDE）的深度状态空间模型提供了统一的理论视角。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a selective review of deep learning-based approaches for state space models, offering a unified perspective on discrete-time and continuous-time deep SSMs, including latent neural ODEs and SDEs.
